items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: I loaned Duke Dewey Maycare Louis Metcalf... I loaned him Dewey Maycare because they could not play the show at the time.

ctx.x: Well, when Duke came into the Cotton Louis Metcalf Club, they would allow that. So I loaned Duke Dewey Maycare Louis Metcalf I loaned him Dewey Maycare because they could not play the show at the time. They were a young band and they didn't know what it was all about. Edith Wilson was working with us in vaudeville. And she asked me, what could I do for Duke, could I help him out with anybody. Because they needed a good strong trumpet player. Because Bubba wasn't a good musician as far as reading was concerned. In…
-calf went to the Cotton Club and was a lifesaver for Duke Ellington at the time.
